explication: OpenShift Docs is an AsciiDoc-based documentation publishing system for OKD and OpenShift products. Authors edit topic content and topic maps; the assembly tooling selects product, distro, and version content, prepares books, and invokes Asciidoctor conversion with custom HTML behavior. Published pages are then consumed through browser features such as search, version navigation, editing links, and clipboard support. The graph emphasizes sampled build and runtime paths; some portal orchestration is inferred from the README and only partially sampled scripts.
